name: Fluocinolone
description: Fluocinolone acetonide, a corticosteroid (anti-inflammatory steroid) used on the skin and scalp

note.text: A PubMed search found no published study of fluocinolone for pattern hair loss.

bullets: **Corticosteroids** act on cell signaling, immune function and inflammation
**Precise mechanism** in scalp psoriasis is unknown, per the label
**Absorbed steroid** can suppress the body's stress-hormone (HPA) axis
**For hair loss,** no mechanism has been studied
Scalp oil: 60% vs 21% cleared or excellent at 21 days

notEstablished.text: Any use for pattern hair loss

practical.routes: On the skin and scalp (ointment, solution, oil)
practical.pharmacokinetics: Absorbed through skin; liver metabolism, kidney excretion
practical.monitored: HPA axis suppression, eyes (glaucoma, cataract), skin
practical.sport: Skin use not prohibited; class S9 bans some routes in competition

regulatory.text: Approved for skin, scalp conditions; not hair loss
Compounded hair sprays are not FDA approved
S9: injected, oral, rectal use banned in competition

references: FDA, Derma-Smoothe/FS Scalp Oil prescribing information (DailyMed), May 2025
FDA, Fluocinolone acetonide topical solution label (DailyMed), Feb 2026
